title: Data Grid Query Engine & Relational Transformers
description: The @ferrox/node datagrid module provides high-performance server-side data grid handling. It converts generic frontend grid request models (AG-Grid, TanStack Table, Material UI DataGrid) into optimized database execution plans with dynamic filtering, dynamic sorting, pagination offset limits, and JOIN condition resolution.
